title: Derived evidence with unknown procedure
purpose: Represent imported derived evidence whose derivation method is unavailable without pretending provenance is known.

provenance.notes: Legacy export labels this as derived but does not expose the procedure.

expected.semantic_interpretation: The evidence remains usable as a derived record while derivation procedure is explicitly unknown.
expected.observability: A derived result was observed from the external source.
expected.opportunity: No opportunity claim is required for this fixture.
expected.time: Phenomenon, observation/result, and ingestion times remain distinct fields.
expected.provenance: procedure_status UNKNOWN prevents fabricated algorithm provenance.
expected.raw_derived: DERIVED_OBSERVATION remains distinct from raw evidence and from patterns.
expected.lineage: No correction, deletion, or supersession is asserted.
expected.must_not_infer: Do not infer a routine, preference, habit, or pattern conclusion.
